I realize there is somewhat of an exodus from reddit happening at the moment. But I come here and all I see is a clone with a goat instead of an adorable alien.

But where's the originality? What's the staying factor? What is supposed to make me come here instead of reddit.

For me, the community is a lot closer... I see the same usernames all over the place.. On reddit most of us felt like a needle in a hay stack.. Here, there's more of an opportunity to develop friendships and have more meaningful conversations..

That's just how I feel anyway.

For now anyway. That was no small blip of traffic from reddit. I've been hanging out in new and posts have gone from one every 10 minutes to one every ten seconds. Hopefully though the reddit exodus spreads out across all the alternatives. Aggregater communities are always better before they reach critical mass.

Yeah, traffic has increased a ton...

Last week I would browse /v/all/new without any issues... Now there's a full page of posts less than a minute old, pretty crazy.

Less nonsense and more actual discussion about the topic at hand. It may change in the next few weeks/months, but I've yet to see a thread involving never ending puns, reaction gifs, or other 'inside jokes'. Don't get me wrong, I laughed occasionally at them, but when an international news story involving some serious or complicated issue devolves to 'REKT!' I get annoyed.

The fact that Reddit has been running the same shit for months on end without actually listening to the users in terms of improvements to be made makes Voat so much more attractive. There's room for another Reddit if it does right what Reddit does wrong.

Voat does have a few differences to try to improve the site (limits on ability to downvote, etc). But honestly, the site wasn't really the problem. The problem was the way that other site was run, with a disregard for the users and mods, and a creeping clamp down on free speech. This is essentially the "under new management" version, and if @atko is true to his word, it will be a great forum for uncensored discussion and sharing.
